title: Notifications do not show on Garmin
symptom: Notifications for new readings no longer appear on the user's Garmin watch, although the persistent notification shows in the notification area. The user has enabled xdrip+ in the Garmin app but the notification fails to show on the watch.
evidence_quote: I've enabled xdrip+ in the Garmin app and the persistent notification does show in the notification area, but fails to do so on my watch.
